hints: 1. Press 1, 2, 3, and 4 to select and control party members
2. Click on the ground to command your characters to move there
3. Click on enemies to send your character to attack them
4. Support characters like Priest can target allies instead
5. Press Q, W, E, R to use the abilities of the selected member
6. Some abilities are instantly used as soon as possible, but some stop time for you to select a target on click
7. When taking damage, the yellow stagger bar fills up, upon which that character is stunned for a time
8. You win once you beat all enemies in an encounter
9. You lose when all your party members die
